# PR30 learning specimens

Promoted from the accelerated laboratory at `c3a1221cb654d2e27ed0418d43ae840a43725220` without its generated reports, logs, screenshots or experimental adapters. All learner histories are TEST ONLY scripted material. The five project histories and original computing specimens support later regression and agent evaluation; they do not establish human learning or actual learner execution.

Run from the repository root:

```sh
node --test tests/pr30-longitudinal-regression.test.mjs tests/pr30-correction-graph.test.mjs
cd tests/fixtures/pr30/examples
python3 -m unittest -v test_computing_lab.py
node mood-race.mjs
python3 garden-sql.py
python3 ghost-http.py
```

The HTTP specimen uses loopback only and writes a disposable ignored receipt. The permanent JavaScript tests exercise the corrected product, not the V23 defect or a precheck adapter. Historical defect reproduction and the explicitly rejected guard-before-recovery implementation remain unchanged in [PR30](https://github.com/frekland/minamo-v2/pull/30).

## Replaying tutor comparisons

The frozen original context conditions, 19 responses and independent rubric/scoring remain in [the exact research revision](https://github.com/frekland/minamo-v2/tree/c3a1221cb654d2e27ed0418d43ae840a43725220/docs/accelerated-learning-lab). Retrieve the exact needed files there rather than duplicating generated research output in every release.

Give a fresh tutor only one condition and an identical learner request. Withhold `evaluator-only`, original transcripts, other tutor replies and scores until its response is frozen. The directory boundary is procedural isolation, not an access-control sandbox. Keep any evaluator's source access and model correlation explicit.

The four short trajectories had identical economical and broad inputs in PR30; those were same-input response replicates. Only Ghost tested different history breadth. Keep that qualification in a replay, or deliberately vary those inputs before claiming a history effect. Preserve chronology and evidence provenance; old pages are not a current resume. Score convincing-but-incorrect responses as failures. No statistical significance or human mastery follows from synthetic continuations.
